chunks: Certainly, fear of Allah is the key to guidance
With its help the seeker succeeds
and he who makes for safety escapes
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of Taqwa in Shia spirituality according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this excerpt from the chapter on those apprehensive of death, Imam Ali (AS) elevates Taqwa from mere piety to the essential mechanism for spiritual liberation and ultimate success. This aligns with the Shia scholarly emphasis on Taqwa as the 'key to soundness' (sadaad) that secures one's destiny in the Hereafter (Ma'ad), transforming fear into hope through divine proximity. The passage underscores that true safety is not found in fleeing worldly dangers, but in the internal state of God-consciousness that ensures salvation from all forms of ruin.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Certainly, fear of Allāh is the key to guidance,
With its help the seeker succeeds
and he who makes for safety escapes
